documents.title: AI in Learning
documents.quality_note: Short student-facing page: instructors decide AI use case by case; promotes boisestate.ai.

documents.title: An approach to discussing AI in your department
documents.quality_note: CS committee recommendations: five GenAI integration scenarios, syllabus blurbs, foundational-skills rationale. Framed as departmental advice in a news post rather than a binding rule.

notes: Policy manual page p=69385 is Data Use Guidelines with only a pointer to AI guidance, so not collected; /genai/ai-policy/ and /ai-tools-and-policy/ cover data and tool governance with no academic-use rules. Academic-integrity AI page (?p=3741) now returns 404. Sample syllabus statements by the AI in Education Task Force exist but no fetchable page was located.
